entries.3ec05a13cac4d1ce: Under its management philosophy “Through reasonably priced hotel operations, realize ‘I’m glad I came, I’ll come again’ and make both guests and employees happy,” the company lists as key issues: improving product value (renovation of entire buildings and adding connecting rooms), strengthening sales promotion and raising room revenue through revenue management, strengthening the customer base through its partnership with FUJITA KANKO INC. and its own booking site, expanding its locations, and securing and developing personnel. It plans to open Washington R&B Hotel Hamamatsu Station South Exit (tentative name) in March 2027.
entries.4bb7b0f04ffc27fa: Located near major stations and downtown areas, it directly operated 18 hotels as of March 31, 2026. Some facilities also have restaurants and banquet halls, and this business also includes contracted operation of restaurants inside golf course clubhouses. Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥11,817 million, and the occupancy rate was 70.3%.
entries.4e0a0cfcaa67959f: Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥24,192 million. By division, the Washington R&B Hotel business was ¥12,174 million and the Washington Hotel Plaza business was ¥11,817 million.
entries.4e677c7b2a97c299: WASHINGTON HOTEL CORPORATION was founded in Nagoya in 1961 and is headquartered in Nagoya City, Aichi Prefecture.
entries.5024325f5abefa91: WASHINGTON HOTEL CORPORATION was founded in Nagoya in 1961 and is headquartered in Nagoya City, Aichi Prefecture. Headcount as of March 31, 2026 was 428.
entries.52c2a24ca50390de: The company directly operates a total of 43 hotels, 18 Washington Hotel Plaza and 25 Washington R&B Hotel, with 9,435 guest rooms in total, and some facilities also have restaurants or banquet halls.
entries.54e2095b2efe8c9c: Operations are in principle carried out by in-house staff, excluding outsourcing of room cleaning and similar tasks, and respond to busy and slow periods through “multi-job” work spanning departments. At R&B Hotels, a small-staff operation in which front desk staff also handle breakfast is thoroughly applied, achieving low prices. Its own booking site, “Washington Net,” returns 7% of lodging fees as points, and membership was 617,000 as of March 31, 2026.

entries.ad7a031e1bca0107: This is a single segment of the hotel business. Under the two brands Washington Hotel Plaza and Washington R&B Hotel, it directly operates 43 hotels nationwide with a total of 9,435 guest rooms as of March 31, 2026. Revenue by business division for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥12,174 million for the Washington R&B Hotel Business, ¥11,817 million for the Washington Hotel Plaza Business, and ¥200 million for other.
